stories.title: Rise in abuse of election candidates is ‘changing politics’ in England

en.title: Rise in abuse of election candidates is 'changing politics' in England
en.summary: England's Electoral Commission reports that abuse of election candidates, particularly targeting women, ethnic minorities, and disabled individuals, has increased significantly and is affecting their political participation. More than half of Labour and Reform UK candidates experienced abuse during this year's local and mayoral elections.

stories.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station

en.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
en.summary: A Russian strike destroyed a stationary Ukrainian locomotive near the Poland border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and European officials departed the area.

stories.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call

en.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
en.summary: Sweden's election authority's partial count indicates the left-wing opposition bloc may secure a narrow three-seat majority, though the outcome remains too uncertain to confirm.

stories.title: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation

en.title: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
en.summary: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after Boris Johnson and senior European officials left the location, with no casualties reported.

stories.title: VAR made ‘error of judgement’ to allow Erling Haaland’s Manchester derby winner, confirms Pro Ref

en.title: VAR made 'error of judgement' to allow Erling Haaland's Manchester derby winner, confirms Pro Ref
en.summary: Pro Ref confirmed that VAR made an error in allowing Erling Haaland's Manchester derby winning goal, as Enzo Fernández appeared to be interfering with play from an offside position.

stories.title: Zverev caps transformational year with US Open triumph

en.title: Zverev caps transformational year with US Open triumph
en.summary: Alexander Zverev won his second Grand Slam title at the US Open, defeating Ben Shelton and preventing the American from becoming a rare homegrown men's champion.

stories.title: Alexander Zverev claims first US Open after four-set battle with Ben Shelton

en.title: Alexander Zverev claims first US Open after four-set battle with Ben Shelton
en.summary: Top seed Alexander Zverev defeated American Ben Shelton in a four-set US Open final, winning 6-3, 7-6 (2), 5-7, 6-2 despite Shelton's late momentum surge in the third set.

stories.title: Alexander Zverev frustrates US Open crowd with ball bouncing and slow pace of serving

en.title: Alexander Zverev frustrates US Open crowd with ball bouncing and slow pace of serving
en.summary: Alexander Zverev faced Ben Shelton, a home favourite, in the US Open final in New York, with the German's playing style drawing crowd frustration.

stories.title: ‘An error of judgement’: Pro Ref admits mistake in awarding Haaland’s derby winner

en.title: 'An error of judgement': Pro Ref admits mistake in awarding Haaland's derby winner
en.summary: The officiating body Pro Ref acknowledged that Erling Haaland's goal in Manchester City's derby victory should not have been allowed, with VAR incorrectly ruling that Enzo Fernández was not interfering with play.

stories.title: Refereeing body admits judgement error over Haaland derby winner

en.title: Refereeing body admits judgement error over Haaland derby winner
en.summary: Pro Ref, the Premier League refereeing body, has acknowledged making an error of judgement in allowing Erling Haaland's winning goal in the Manchester derby.

stories.title: Haaland scores controversial winner as Man City win derby despite Foden red

en.title: Haaland scores controversial winner as Man City win derby despite Foden red
en.summary: Manchester City defeated Manchester United in a controversial Manchester derby with Erling Haaland scoring the winning goal, even though City played with ten men for over 70 minutes following a red card to Foden.

stories.title: Train carrying Boris Johnson and ex-CIA chief may have been targeted in Russian strike, officials say

en.title: Train carrying Boris Johnson and ex-CIA chief may have been targeted in Russian strike, officials say
en.summary: Ukrainian Railways reports that a train carrying former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson and ex-CIA chief David Petraeus may have been targeted by a Russian drone strike near the Poland-Ukraine border, shortly after the passengers crossed into Poland.

en.title: Michael Dell's family office leads $7.7bn deal to take insurance broker private
en.summary: Michael Dell's family office and Sequence are leading an acquisition of Baldwin Group, an insurance broker, as the industry experiences consolidation.

en.title: Gulf states postpone talks with Iran over Hormuz impasse
en.summary: Gulf states have delayed scheduled negotiations with Iran regarding shipping access through the Strait of Hormuz due to disagreement among participants on key issues.

en.title: Anthropic tells investors it will be profitable for second straight quarter
en.summary: Anthropic, the maker of Claude, has informed investors of profitability expectations for a second consecutive quarter ahead of a major initial public offering.

en.title: Swedish election on a knife-edge
en.summary: Sweden, the Nordic region's largest economy, faces weeks of uncertainty as the nation prepares for complex government formation negotiations following closely contested election results.

stories.title: Trump rejects calls from tech bosses for AI slowdown

en.title: Trump rejects calls from tech bosses for AI slowdown
en.summary: President Trump has rejected demands from technology leaders for artificial intelligence regulation, as concerns about the technology's existential risks gain prominence in US political debate.
